HunterSession.title: HunterSession
HunterSession.description: Represents a hunter's daily tactical RPG fitness, nutrition, biometric profile, and progression session.

userId.description: The authenticated UID of the hunter who owns this session.

rank.description: Hunter rank designation (e.g., E-Rank Hunter, D-Rank Hunter).

nextLevelXp.description: XP threshold required to advance to the next level.

progressPercent.description: Percentage progress toward the next level.

omega3Mg.description: Milligrams of omega-3 fatty acids logged.

targetLiters.description: Daily target water intake in liters.

workoutCompleted.description: Whether the daily strength routine was completed.

tacticalBriefing.description: 2-3 sentences of motivating, actionable tactical feedback.

stateJson.description: Serialized tactical snapshot containing quests, achievements, buffs, debuffs, exercises, suggested actions, and hunter biometric profile.

TacticalLog.title: TacticalLog
TacticalLog.description: An action or AI command entry logged by the hunter.

userId.description: The authenticated UID of the hunter.

commandText.description: The user's logged input (e.g., 'i had 2000 kcal').

briefingResponse.description: The system's tactical briefing for this entry.

xpDelta.description: XP awarded from this tactical entry.

JournalEntry.title: JournalEntry
JournalEntry.description: A personal progress journal entry automatically created when the hunter updates their biometric profile or uploads a progress photo.

userId.description: The authenticated UID of the hunter.

caption.description: Detailed notes, caption, or biometric summary.

poseTag.description: Physique pose or category tag (e.g., Front Relaxed, Back Lat Spread, Biometric Sync).

photoBase64.description: Optional compressed Base64 JPEG image data for progress photos (empty string if biometric-only entry).

weightKg.description: Recorded body weight in kilograms at time of entry.

heightCm.description: Recorded height in centimeters at time of entry.

age.description: Recorded age in years at time of entry.

bmi.description: Calculated Body Mass Index (BMI) at time of entry.

bodyFatPercent.description: Calculated body fat percentage at time of entry.

muscleMassPercent.description: Calculated skeletal muscle mass percentage at time of entry.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of journal entry creation (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

FeedbackEntry.title: FeedbackEntry
FeedbackEntry.description: Public app feedback submitted by hunters that the app creator receives and tracks for product improvements.

userId.description: The authenticated UID of the user submitting the feedback.

hunterName.description: Display codename of the hunter submitting feedback (non-PII).

message.description: Detailed feedback or feature suggestion from the public.

status.description: Triage status managed by the app creator.

visibility.description: Visibility scope for community feedback board queries.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Stores the hunter's active and historical daily status sessions.

/users/{userId}/logs/{logId}.description: Stores chronological tactical command logs and AI briefings for the hunter.

/users/{userId}/journal/{entryId}.description: Stores chronological personal journal entries with progress photos and biometric snapshots.

/feedback/{feedbackId}.description: Stores public app feedback received by the app creator for product updates.
